pricing_page.notes: Public page lists pay-as-you-go prices and enterprise pricing.

employee_band.notes: The company's LinkedIn profile reports 51–200 employees, while PitchBook reports 60 total employees; 60 places it in the requested 51–100 band.

model_provider.notes: The docs describe in-house models and OpenAI compatibility/integration; the pricing page names ChatGPT models. No claim is made that OpenAI is the provider behind Smallest's proprietary models.
model_provider.value: Smallest.ai publicly identifies its own model family (including Lightning, Pulse, Hydra, and Electron) and also documents OpenAI model integrations, including ChatGPT and a migration guide for OpenAI; it does not disclose a single exclusive underlying provider.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The integrations page is readable but names no CRM or sales-and-marketing systems; its listed products are agent, automation, SDK, AI gateway, and telephony tools.
